title: Timeline playback controls: play/stop/rewind + frame counter
description: Stage scrubbing works but there are no playback controls. Add below-timeline transport: (1) Play (Enter/Return) — animates from currentFrame forward at fps, using requestAnimationFrame and the document frameRate; (2) Stop (Enter again or Esc) — halts playback and returns to where it started; (3) Rewind to frame 1 button (|◁); (4) Frame counter input (read/write) — type a frame number to jump to it; (5) FPS display. State: isPlaying boolean in Shell.tsx; a useInterval or requestAnimationFrame loop that increments currentFrame each tick. At the last frame, wrap to frame 1 (loop) or stop. The play loop should use getTweenedFrame for interpolated stage display. Wire Enter/Space key to toggle play/stop in StageArea.tsx. See docs/02-timeline-animation.md.
